atom('V','C',1360,727); atom('MeV','C',1435,690); atom('vinylCH2','C',1360,845)
# key connections
bond('T0','Obridge'); bond('T0','I'); bond('T0','T1')
bond('T1','T2'); bond('T1','T5'); bond('T2','T3'); bond('T3','T4')
bond('T4','T6'); bond('T6','T5',1,'down'); bond('T6','T7'); bond('T6','T4')
# T5 connects left heteroring and methyl, also T1 & T6
bond('J','T5')
bond('T5','MeT5',1,'down')
# second carbocycle
bond('T7','T8'); bond('T8','T9'); bond('T9','T10'); bond('T10','T4'); bond('T9','Ocyc')
# right O ring and alkene
bond('T10','T11',2); bond('T11','T12'); bond('T12','T13'); bond('T13','Ocyc'); bond('T12','OH12',1,'down')
bond('T13','V'); bond('V','MeV'); bond('V','vinylCH2',2)

 ('HwF','Fcy',185,174,'down'),('HwD','Dcy',397,316,'down'),

 atom(name,'H',x,y); bond(center,name,1,d)
